body: Lead spec of a 2-layer sequenced program (author choice 2026-06-15): sibling-context FIRST, hierarchical head SECOND, each shipped as a gated PATCH (NOT 0.7.0). Probe-first (ac-01 gate) because efficacy on our boundaries is unproven — coordinates strong prior, currency uncertain. Builds on the abandoned 2026-03-24-sibling-context-multi-branch (closed 0/7, stranded at integration). See memory sibling-context-is-the-stranded-architecture-layer.

ac-01 GO (gate cleared): sibling-context separates coordinates at AUC 0.956 vs 0.716 value-only (+0.24) — a latitude col almost always has a longitude-NAMED sibling (95-96% vs 2% for decimals). SCOPE CORRECTION: currency is header-decisive (own-header AUC 0.964) not sibling-decisive (0.655) — dropped from this spec, stays with the currency/training path. Lead target for ac-02 build = coordinates + other sibling-paired types. Signal is sibling HEADER embeddings, not value ranges. See ac01_efficacy_probe.md.

SWEEP (all boundaries) REVISES the ac-01 GO: sibling-context mechanism is real (latitude has 'longitude' sibling 87% vs 2% decimals, confirmed 2nd way) BUT coordinates are already solved on gold (recall 1.000/0.978 = ~1 col headroom) AND the actual recall gaps (categorical 54FN, integer 40, plain_text 31, alnum 18, date.iso 15, decimal 13) are NOT sibling-recoverable (no distinctive sibling token). country/'high' + terms/'year' GO hits are small-n(10) noise, no headroom. => DO NOT start the ac-02 sibling FTMB-v3 build as a recall bet; its only honest value is advisory corpus-precision coordinate hardening. Recommend probing the hierarchical head (program layer 2) before any build. Probe-first just saved a multi-week build. See ac01_sweep_output.txt.

LAYER-2 PROBE (hierarchical head) = REAL bet, re-order recommended. v19 gold: leaf 0.782 / family 0.801 / DOMAIN 0.878 — knows domain but misses leaf on 89 cols. Of 203 leaf errors: 87 cross-domain (43%) + 27 unknown (13%) = HIERARCHY CEILING +12.2% gold (vs sibling-context ~1 col); only 18 (9%) within-family irreducible. Caveat: ceiling needs a domain head that beats v19's 0.878 on the HARD columns (where its leaf already went cross-domain — trunk signal weakest there). Head already built (char_cnn.rs HeadType::Hierarchical, use_hierarchical flag), needs NO new data format → far cheaper than sibling FTMB-v3. RECOMMEND: hierarchical head FIRST; next test = small hierarchical training run, leaf-recall + domain-acc vs flat. Sibling-context demotes to advisory coord-precision. See ac06_hierarchical_head_probe.md.
